purpose: Train a separate CUDA native-effect forecaster on many recorded transitions, not a selector fitted on four root states. Keep all four explored MC worlds out of fitting/development; use their accepted local alternative effects as a separate counterfactual challenge. No actor, critic, policy std, default or runtime change.
splits: Baseline plan seeds at slots0..2 are TRAIN and slot3 development, matching the existing movement collection. Preserve whole-world splits across variants. Remove all challenge world seeds from TRAIN/development entirely. Existing development is exploratory, not a new quality confirmation. Previously inspected challenge worlds are a technical challenge, not independent campaign evidence.
sources: Only the32CUDA-verified ordinary baseline cases and107CUDA-verified one-frame movement cases. Every model must equal the source after removing diagnostic headers. Other-policy/validation/confirmation corpora excluded. Diagnostic data feed auxiliary native-effect supervision only, never ordinary PPO/actor fitting.
root_filter: First-life provider decisions with at least one observed enemy, known CUDA features/sample and exact exclusive native dispatch. Stop before verified task completion/death. Exclude roots preceding a not-yet-started diagnostic intervention when it lies within the largest forecast horizon, because that future intervention is not a root input.
targets: Cumulative native effects until H or first independently verified goal/death, whichever comes first. A verified terminal is an explicitly stopped target, not zero filling unobserved physical effects. All native steps up to that stop must be provider-owned, matched, exclusive and available. Nonterminal handoff, trace end, missing dispatch/effects/observation leaves the horizon masked; never interpret it as success/death/zero.
input: 1147 pre-command features; source and final latent4 each; actual attack; one-hot target9/aim_mode2/vertical3/weapon12; active declared future movement shift2 and remaining window frames1. Total1185. Seed/map/fork seed and future states/effects are grouping metadata or labels only. For zero shift remaining=0. Candidate inputs condition on actual sampled root action, not a mean-action approximation.
weighting: Balance whole worlds and then world-frame groups, dividing repeated branch samples within the same world/frame. Do not call duplicated replay prefixes independent observations. Do not deduplicate by target value, which would distort outcome frequencies.
storage: Per-case compressed NPZ chunks with float32 feature/action/effect arrays and boolean known masks, plus small JSON provenance. Retain original captures unchanged. Streaming case processing, no new games or assets.
outputs: For each H: incoming/dealt/kill/death event logits, softplus expected received/dealt amounts. Minimize BCE for four events plus squared error on raw amounts scaled by20, known horizons only.

training.state_only: Identical initialization/batches/architecture, action block zeroed. No CPU neural fallback or checkpoint search.

evaluation: Weighted development BCE/RMSE and constant TRAIN-target baseline. Separate actual-action counterfactual challenge on all four held-out worlds: alternative-minus-control and long-minus-short amount deltas, per-stream and four-stream mean errors versus zero-effect baseline. Preserve unknown masks. No seed/map as features. No claim that observed four-stream means are true Q.
next: Only a passed predictive and counterfactual gate justifies implementing learned candidate evaluation and a fresh native quality screen. Otherwise preserve negative results and revise data/targets before runtime changes. No promotion or full-combat improvement inferred from prediction metrics.
